Read More Specs General Brand Name Sony GameStop Exclusive false Features Features Bluetooth, Wi-Fi Compatible Connectivity Connection Type Wireless Dimension Product Length 14 Product Width 3.88 Product Height 6 Product Unit of Measure in Product Weight 2.6 Product Weight Unit of Measure lbs FAQs Frequently Asked Questions Who is the PlayStation Portal Remote Player for? The PS Portal is perfect for busy parents and gamers on the go. It's the ideal choice for those who crave flexibility and convenience in their PS5 gameplay. Do I need Wi-Fi in order to play the PlayStation Portal Remote Player? Yes. The PlayStation Portal Remote Player can be enjoyed on your home Wi-Fi network or any broadband internet Wi-Fi connection with at least 5Mbps. While using your home Wi-Fi network allows you to have control over the quality of your gaming experience, it is not a requirement. For an enhanced play experience, it is recommended to have a high-speed connection of at least 15Mbps. However, if you choose to use public Wi-Fi, keep in mind that the quality of the internet connection may vary and could affect your gaming experience. Do I need a PlayStation Plus membership to use PlayStation Portal and PlayStation Remote Play? No. You do not need a PlayStation Plus membership to use the PlayStation Portal and PlayStation® Remote Play. However, if you want to play a game that requires a PS Plus membership for multiplayer access, you will need an active membership to enjoy the multiplayer features of that game. Can someone else use the TV my PS5 is connected to while I am using PlayStation Portal Remote Player? Yes, they can. Someone else in your household can watch a TV show or movie watching a show while you use PlayStation Portal Remote Player to play your favorite compatible games on its gorgeous 8” HD screen.
